defaultExplain.en: Unsolicited SMS requires prior consent in the Netherlands, including to businesses (Telecommunicatiewet art. 11.7); the channel is blocked for prospecting.
defaultExplain.fr: Les SMS non sollicités requièrent un consentement préalable aux Pays-Bas, y compris envers les entreprises (Telecommunicatiewet art. 11.7) ; le canal est bloqué pour la prospection.

sources.title: Overloop — Dutch and Belgian cold-acquisition law overview (Sep 2026)
